# Architecture & PR Review Checklist: 外部 UI 分析索引消费与通用索引生产规则

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements in spec.md are complete, unambiguous, and internally
consistent enough to support architecture review and PR review of the index-consumption feature —
this is a check on the REQUIREMENTS TEXT, not on any implementation or test execution.
**Created**: 2026-07-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context
and requirements. It was originally derived solely from `spec.md`, before `plan.md`/`tasks.md`
existed. As of 2026-07-25 all 38 items pass — the remaining items that `spec.md` alone left
underspecified were closed by the Phase 0/1 design (`research.md`, `data-model.md`,
`contracts/*.md`) and by `tasks.md`; see the Notes section below for the resolution ledger and
exact citations per item.

## 生产方/消费方职责边界与只读范围 (Producer/Consumer Boundary & Read-Only Scope)

- [x] CHK001 Is the boundary between "读取已生成的分析结果" and "分析/解析源码" precisely bounded,
      and is the list of prohibited dependencies/actions (Roslyn, MSBuildWorkspace, JavaParser,
      TypeScript Compiler, opening `.sln`/`.csproj`) stated as an exhaustive constraint class or
      only as illustrative examples — is the scope unambiguous for judging future dependency
      additions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, §FR-018]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec define, for every consumer-side capability (read/validate/query/
      runtime-hint/audit), a corresponding "producer does not need to do this" statement, so
      responsibility is unambiguous at each capability boundary rather than only at the aggregate
      feature level? [Completeness, Spec §Input, §FR-001–FR-019]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified whether the current project may ever write back to, normalize, cache,
      or otherwise mutate any part of a producer-supplied bundle, or is the read-only nature
      strictly end-to-end with no exceptions? [Gap]

## Bundle 文件与 Schema 版本契约 (Bundle File & Schema Version Contract)

- [x] CHK004 Are all required and optional bundle files enumerated with exact file names and
      formats (YAML vs. JSONL) in one authoritative place, and do FR-002, FR-022, and the Key
      Entities "Bundle 文件布局" entry reference the identical list without divergence? [Consistency,
      Spec §FR-002, §FR-022, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK005 Is the schema version numbering scheme (MAJOR.MINOR) fully specified, including how a
      producer declares it (which file/field carries it) and how the consumer reads it during
      validation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK006 Is "reject unsupported major version" defined with a concrete, testable boundary (e.g.,
      is the currently supported major version enumerated anywhere), or only described as
      "受支持" without a way for a reviewer to check a specific bundle's version against it?
      [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 Is the requirement that unknown fields within a supported major version "必须被保留"
      specified uniformly across every file type (manifest, screens, elements, transitions, flows,
      diagnostics), or could a reader interpret it as applying to only one file? [Consistency,
      Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]

## 标准结果概念的字段完整性 (Screen/Element/Transition/Flow/Diagnostic Field Completeness)

- [x] CHK008 Are the required vs. optional fields for Screen enumerated explicitly beyond "稳定 ID"
      and an optional summary, or could two independent producers reasonably disagree on what else
      a Screen record must contain? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities "Screen"]
- [x] CHK009 Are the required vs. optional fields for Diagnostic/Unresolved Item enumerated (e.g.,
      target reference, reason, confidence, evidence), or is the entity described only narratively
      without a field list a validator could check against? [Gap, Spec §Key Entities
      "Diagnostic / Unresolved Item"]
- [x] CHK010 Is the internal structure of a Flow record specified precisely enough to validate
      (ordered list of transition IDs vs. an unordered set vs. a directed graph), or does "有序或
      有向组合" leave the shape ambiguous for both producers and the consumer's validator?
      [Ambiguity, Spec §Key Entities "Flow"]
- [x] CHK011 Are field data types (string/enum/float/boolean/list) specified for Element and
      Transition fields anywhere, at a level sufficient for FR-002's "各文件字段类型正确性" to be
      objectively checked, or only their meaning described in prose? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002,
      §Key Entities "Element", "Transition"]
- [x] CHK012 Does the spec define whether "支持的动作" and 跳转类型
      (modal/replace/overlay/state-change) are drawn from a closed enumeration or an open
      vocabulary, and is that treatment consistent between the entity descriptions and FR-004's
      query dimensions? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-004]

## 稳定 ID 与引用完整性 (Stable IDs & Referential Integrity)

- [x] CHK013 Is "稳定 ID" defined with concrete uniqueness/stability criteria (unique within bundle,
      stable across producer regeneration), or only asserted as a property without a testable
      definition of "stable"? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK014 Does the spec resolve the Edge Case of an Element's `parent` reference pointing to
      itself or forming a cycle as an explicit validation failure, or does the requirement stop at
      raising the question without stating the resolution? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK015 Does the spec resolve the Edge Case of a Transition's guards/preconditions referencing
      a state declaration absent from the bundle — is this covered by FR-002's "跨文件引用完整性",
      or does it remain an open question with no stated answer? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK016 Is "跨文件引用完整性" scoped exhaustively — FR-002 names element→screen and
      transition→screen/element via "等" (etc.) — does the spec enumerate every reference
      relationship that must be checked, including Flow→Screen/Transition and Diagnostic→target
      references? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]

## 坐标、区域、邻接关系与可信度语义 (Coordinate / Region / Adjacency / Confidence Semantics)

- [x] CHK017 Is "坐标空间" (coordinate space) itself defined as an explicit declared field/concept
      anywhere in the spec, or does FR-002's "落在声明的坐标空间范围内" presuppose a concept (what
      values it can take, who declares it, at what granularity) that is never specified? [Ambiguity,
      Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK018 Is the relationship between an Element's "设计布局或归一化布局（可选）" and its "相对区域"
      specified precisely — are they the same field expressed two ways, or two independent optional
      fields, and if independent, which governs when they disagree? [Ambiguity, Spec §Key Entities
      "Element"]
- [x] CHK019 Are "上下左右或附近元素" (neighbor) semantics specified as fixed directional slots vs. an
      open/unordered list, and is this consistent with FR-004's "邻接元素" query dimension and
      FR-007's "邻接文字" runtime hint? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities "Element", §FR-004, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK020 Is the confidence (可信度) field's representation reconciled between FR-002's "落在合法
      取值范围内" (implying a scalar/enum range check) and FR-025's four-category taxonomy
      (confirmed / statically inferred / visually confirmed / requires runtime verification) — is
      confidence one field with a fixed value set, or two related-but-distinct fields, and is that
      made explicit anywhere? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK021 Is "证据来源" (evidence source) specified with a defined shape (free text vs. a
      structured reference), sufficient for FR-005's "preserve confidence and evidence source" to be
      objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005, §Key Entities]

## 无索引/无命中/无效索引的行为契约 (No-Index / No-Match / Invalid-Index Behavior)

- [x] CHK022 Is FR-011's "系统行为...MUST 与本 feature 实现前完全一致" accompanied by a concrete,
      checkable definition of "行为一致" (same decision path, same output artifacts, same audit
      absence), or is it left as a qualitative claim a reviewer cannot mechanically verify?
      [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK023 Does the spec define the exact, closed set of conditions that constitute "索引无效"
      (FR-012), traceable one-to-one to FR-002's validation checks, or could "无效" be interpreted
      more broadly by different implementers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK024 Is the distinction between "索引中找不到当前画面" and "索引与当前截图明显不一致" specified
      with criteria a reviewer could use to determine which audit reason applies to a given
      situation, beyond the qualitative visual-noise-tolerance note in Assumptions? [Clarity,
      Spec §FR-013, §FR-014, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK025 Does the spec require that "无效索引→执行前失败" and "无命中→回退继续" produce
      distinguishable, non-overlapping outcomes and audit/error codes so the two cannot be
      conflated by an implementation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014]

## Grounder/Verifier 安全边界 (Grounder/Verifier Safety Boundaries)

- [x] CHK026 Is "绕过 Grounder" (FR-009) defined precisely enough to distinguish a compliant design
      (index hints feed Grounder's decision inputs) from a non-compliant one (index coordinates flow
      directly to the click-dispatch path), beyond the general prohibition statement? [Clarity,
      Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK027 Does the spec require that the audit trail record each click's coordinate provenance
      (index-informed vs. purely screenshot-derived), so that SC-004's "no click coordinate ever
      equals an index-supplied coordinate" claim is actually verifiable after the fact rather than
      only asserted? [Gap, Spec §SC-004, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK028 Is it explicit that a Transition's "预期新增/消失的可见元素" may be consumed by the
      Verifier only as a hint and never as a pass/fail input, and is this consistent with the
      general Verifier-independence requirements stated elsewhere? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008,
      §FR-010, §FR-019]

## 模型上下文隐私边界 (Model-Context Privacy Boundary)

- [x] CHK029 Is the list of fields permitted in model-facing context (visible text, alias, role,
      relative region, neighbor text) closed/exhaustive, or could an implementer add another
      "visible" field (e.g., z-order) without violating FR-015 as written? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK030 Does the spec give a rule for borderline fields where "可见语义" and "非可见实现细节"
      could overlap (e.g., a `role` value that happens to equal a UI framework's internal
      control-type string), or is the boundary left to implementer judgment? [Ambiguity, Spec
      §FR-015]
- [x] CHK031 Does the spec require a structural mechanism (e.g., an allow-list transform) to
      guarantee offline-provenance fields never leak into model-facing context, or does SC-007's
      "抽查" (spot check) imply this is verified only by manual sampling rather than by a structural
      guarantee? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, §SC-007]

## 错误处理、资源限制与完整性校验 (Error Handling, Resource Limits & Integrity Checks)

- [x] CHK032 Is bundle checksum verification mandatory or optional — FR-002 says "如提供" (if
      provided) — and if optional, does the spec define how partial-write/truncation is still
      detected when no checksum is present? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK033 Are all error conditions raised as open questions in Edge Cases (e.g., circular parent
      reference, dangling guard reference — see CHK014/CHK015) each traceable to a corresponding
      FR that states the required handling, or do some Edge Cases remain unresolved questions with
      no matching requirement? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK034 Is "超出预设资源限制" specified with enough structural detail (which dimension: file
      size, record count, total bundle size) for producers and reviewers to reason about
      conformance, even though exact numeric thresholds are intentionally deferred to
      implementation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §Assumptions]

## 审计与报告 (Audit & Reporting)

- [x] CHK035 Does FR-013's audit-record requirement specify how index-usage audit entries relate to
      the project's existing run-trace/report artifacts (a new artifact type vs. embedded fields in
      existing logical-capture/HTML/JSON reports), or is that relationship left unspecified? [Gap,
      Spec §FR-013, §SC-006, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK036 Is the audit record's "未命中原因" field constrained to an enumerated set of reasons, or
      could free-text reasons make SC-006's "100% 覆盖率" claim practically unverifiable? [Measurability,
      Spec §FR-013, §SC-006]

## 通用 Producer Skill 可移植性与跨场景验证 (Producer Skill Portability & Cross-Scenario Validation)

- [x] CHK037 Do the consumer-side capabilities (bundle validation, query, runtime hint injection,
      fallback+audit — User Stories 1–3) each carry an explicit two-unrelated-fixture validation
      requirement the way the producer skill's portability does (SC-008) and core-code
      business-agnosticism does (SC-009), or does the "至少两个互不相关 GUI fixture" obligation apply
      only to the producer skill and not to the consumer runtime path? [Gap, Spec §SC-008, §SC-009,
      §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Is "互不相关" (unrelated) defined with any criteria (different industry, different UI
      framework/toolkit, different navigation topology) sufficient for a reviewer to reject two
      fixtures that are only superficially different, and does the two-fixture validation requirement
      extend to exercising the error-handling matrix (§Edge Cases / FR-002) rather than only the
      happy-path capabilities? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 4, §SC-008, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Review 2026-07-25 (initial pass): 9/38 items passed based on `spec.md` alone: CHK001, CHK004,
  CHK006, CHK007, CHK013, CHK023, CHK026, CHK028, and CHK034.
- Review 2026-07-25 (after integrating clarifications): CHK014, CHK015, CHK017, CHK020, CHK033,
  and CHK037 now pass — `spec.md` was updated to resolve the Element `parent`-cycle and Transition
  dangling-guard Edge Cases as explicit FR-002 validation failures, to define `coordinate_space`
  (`design_pixels` | `normalized_1000`) as an explicit declared field, to unify the confidence
  field into one composite `level` + optional `score` structure referenced consistently by
  FR-002/FR-025/Key Entities, to map every remaining open Edge Case question to a resolving FR
  (JSONL syntax → FR-002; duplicate query matches → FR-004; directory-not-found vs. invalid-bundle
  → FR-003; index-hit vs. grounding-outcome → FR-013), and to add SC-011 requiring the consumer-side
  capabilities (User Stories 1–3) to each be validated across at least two unrelated GUI fixtures.
  As a side effect of unifying the confidence structure, the Diagnostic/Unresolved Item entity also
  now enumerates its fields (target reference, reason, confidence, evidence source), which resolves
  CHK009 as well. Running total: 16/38 items passing.
- Review 2026-07-25 (final pass, after `/speckit-plan` + `/speckit-tasks` + `/speckit-analyze`
  remediation): the remaining 22 items now pass — resolved by the Phase 0/1 design artifacts and
  `tasks.md` rather than by further `spec.md` edits (consistent with the "may be more naturally
  resolved during `/speckit-plan`" note this file carried when it was created). Resolution ledger:
  - **Producer/consumer boundary** — CHK002 (the two separate contracts,
    `contracts/ui-analysis-bundle-v1.md` for the producer and
    `contracts/ui-index-consumer-interfaces.md` for the consumer, make the per-capability split
    structural rather than left to prose), CHK003 (`plan.md` Storage: "生产方交付的只读 bundle
    目录，vnc-agent 不写回").
  - **Bundle contract completeness** — CHK005, CHK008, CHK010, CHK011, CHK012, CHK016, CHK018,
    CHK019, CHK021 all resolved by the full field-level tables and explicit type/shape/reference
    rules in `contracts/ui-analysis-bundle-v1.md` and `data-model.md` §1 (e.g. Flow's `steps` is
    now an explicit ordered list — data-model.md §1.9; `region` vs `normalized_bounds` are two
    independent fields with distinct roles — research.md §6; neighbor directions are a fixed
    5-value enum allowing repeats — research.md §7/data-model.md §1.4; `supported_actions`/
    `trigger_action` are open snake_case vocab while `transition_type` stays closed — research.md
    §8).
  - **Behavioral contracts** — CHK022 (FR-011's "行为一致" is now operationalized by concrete
    diff-based test procedures: tasks.md T041/T044, quickstart.md §四), CHK024 (research.md §9's
    `match_score`/`missing_ratio` thresholds + data-model.md §4.2's closed `no_match_reason` enum
    give reviewers a mechanical way to tell the two outcomes apart), CHK025 (`ValidationReport`
    errors and `IndexUsageAuditRecord.outcome` are separate types on separate code paths by
    construction, plus dedicated tests T041 vs T038).
  - **Coordinate provenance** — CHK027: `contracts/ui-index-consumer-interfaces.md` §9 now
    documents that `GroundingCandidate.reason` carries a `"ui_index:"` prefix for index-derived
    candidates (tasks.md T051 implements it, T040 tests it), so SC-004 is verifiable from the
    existing run trace without a new field.
  - **Model-context privacy** — CHK029 (`VisibleElementHint` is a closed 7-field Pydantic model,
    data-model.md §4.1), CHK030 (the allow-list operates on field identity, not content
    heuristics, so there is no runtime "borderline content" ambiguity — research.md §10), CHK031
    (`to_visible_hint()`'s allow-list is a structural code-review-checkable guarantee, not manual
    sampling — contracts/ui-index-consumer-interfaces.md §5).
  - **Integrity & audit** — CHK032 (checksum is explicitly optional; contracts §2 states which
    other checks still apply when it's absent), CHK035 (`ui_index_audit` is an embedded field on
    the existing `ActionIteration`, not a new artifact type — data-model.md §5), CHK036
    (`no_match_reason` is a closed `Literal` of two values, not free text — data-model.md §4.2).
  - **Cross-scenario coverage** — CHK038: "互不相关" is now given concrete criteria (T011/T012
    are required to use disjoint vocabulary and distinct UI concepts — tasks.md Phase 2), and the
    error-handling-matrix requirement is now wired to a real task (T023's `dangling_reference`
    case is built from a copy of T011, not just T010), closing the gap SC-011 called for.
  Final: 38/38 items passing.
- This checklist evaluates the WRITTEN REQUIREMENTS (spec.md plus its downstream design artifacts)
  for completeness, clarity, and consistency. It does not evaluate any implementation — no code
  exists yet for this feature; passing here means the requirements are unambiguous enough to
  implement against, not that the implementation is correct.
